project.title: CADH-GT: Confidence-Aware Graph and Causal Temporal Modeling for Bimanual Webcam Gesture Control

contract.gap: Isolated-gesture accuracy does not establish safe continuous command emission from a bimanual webcam stream.
contract.task: Evaluate a confidence-aware causal graph-temporal model for an 18-command bimanual desktop-control vocabulary.

questions.text: What recognition performance and failure modes does CADH-GT exhibit on participant-disjoint validation data?

contract.contribution: A diagnostic evaluation of a causal bimanual graph-temporal research prototype with confidence-aware spatial encoding and dual temporal branches.

alignment.method: Train and evaluate the 1,135,889-parameter CADH-GT model on participant-disjoint 48-frame bimanual landmark windows.
alignment.evidence: Primary and secondary validation metrics, per-class results, boundary results, confusion counts, and test-time augmentation comparison.
alignment.result: Primary action macro-F1 0.6439, mode macro-F1 0.9510, boundary macro-F1 0.5750; large per-command variation and weak offset recognition.
alignment.interpretation: The prototype recognizes coarse modes and several mode-distinct commands more reliably than similar click, drag, and boundary events.
alignment.limitation: Single validation participant, no untouched test set, repeated seeds, matched baselines, ablations, calibrated rejection study, or end-to-end runtime evaluation.
alignment.contribution: Evidence-bounded characterization of architecture performance and failure modes.

decisions.decision: Remove repository paths, internal directory names, console-transcript references, and architecture-report references while preserving scientific meaning and reported evidence.
